result.quote: Jehoiada sent for the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, and the guards, and had them brought into the house of the LORD.
result.reason: The key is supported, but the wording permits another defensible pair: Jehoiada sent for the commanders and had them brought into the house of the LORD before showing them the king’s son. To make the intended answer unique, ask: “After having the commanders brought into the house of the LORD, what two things did Jehoiada do before showing them the king’s son?” The edit otherwise preserves the source pair’s intended covenant-and-oath target.
